label: Historical e4aa1b0 compute-only prototype
adaptations: Extracted only the original TF32 kernel and reachable device helpers; omitted unused host benchmark and unrelated kernels.
Wrapped symbols in a namespace and converted macros to same-valued namespace constexpr constants.
Preserved all executable kernel statements, loop-unroll directives, commented-out work, and indeterminate B operands. No correctness repairs or optimizations were applied.
omitted_work: The fill_reg_b call is commented out; automatic reg_frag_b values are read without initialization.

launch.twiddle_pointer: Unused by the extracted executable closure; nullptr is valid.

original_host_twiddle.effect: The omitted fill_reg_b call means these values are not read by this prototype. A common float-PI timing harness does not change its executed twiddle work.

mma_work.interpretation: Issued dense MMA FLOPs, excluding scalar/control/shared-memory work. The transform-slot count describes launch geometry and does not certify a valid FFT.

extraction_build_comparison.scope: Build and instruction comparison only; no GPU numerical test. The generated MMA instructions were retained despite the indeterminate B operands.

compiler_dependence: Uninitialized automatic B-fragment values are indeterminate. Source-level numerical semantics are undefined; compiler changes or surrounding code may change operand allocation and the emitted workload. Retain binary hashes and inspect generated MMA instructions for each compiler/architecture.
source_scope: Function-limited historical timing; no numerical FFT or complete Table 7 reproduction claim.
communication: The global wrapper loads register input from shared memory, executes three MMA stages with two permutations, stores to shared memory, and synchronizes once per repeat.
